SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, category_name, images, infos, price, shipping_price FROM product WHERE product_id = #{productId}

mapper.select: SELECT product_option_id, product_id, option_name, option_price, is_required, is_quantity_adjustable FROM product_option WHERE (product_id = #{productId} OR product_id IS NULL) ORDER BY option_name DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_option ( product_id, option_name, option_price, is_required, is_quantity_adjustable ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{optionName}, #{optionPrice}, #{isRequired}, #{isQuantityAdjustable} )
